title: Leutascher Geisterklamm
highlights: Spektakulaerer 800 Meter langer kuehner Stahlsteg direkt an den Felswaenden der Klamm
Schwindelerregende Panoramabruecke hoch ueber dem tosenden Wasserfall
Klammgeistweg mit interaktiven Hoerstationen und Sagenwelten fuer Kinder
Grenzueberschreitendes Naturerlebnis zwischen Tirol und Bayern
kurzbeschreibung: The Leutascher Geisterklamm fascinates visitors with an 800-metre-long cliff walkway, a daring panoramic bridge, and the legend of the gorge spirit.
beschreibung:
Daring Walkway Through the Rock Gorge

The Leutascher Geisterklamm forms a spectacular natural border between Tyrol and Bavaria. A masterfully engineered, cantilevered steel walkway safely guides hikers along 800 metres through the roaring gorge of the Leutascher Ache.

The Realm of the Gorge Spirit for Families

Along the Klammgeistweg, explorers of all ages immerse themselves in the mystical world of goblins and water spirits. The undisputed highlight is the daring panoramic bridge, spanning the chasm at dizzying heights and offering dramatic downward views of the roaring waterfall.
